branch.model: the dwarven isolate; no human analog

_note: Dwarven demihuman culture, the VOLCANIC fire-dialect of the Durn (family_dwarven.json). The same tongue as Khordurn with only SMALL drift - the fire-dialect hardens and geminates (Orlundrumm -> Orlunndrumm, varnak -> varnakk) and tends o toward u, a crackling clipped edge - so a word is plainly the same as the mountain or frost dialect. Root gorm = the dark ember / banked fire; Gormdurn = 'the ember-folk'. They delve the world's own forge-fire, the volcanoes, and lean hardest of all dwarves into the fire-powers: predominantly Neutral but with a strong Chaotic fire-cult minority - weights {Lawful 0.10, Neutral 0.60, Chaotic 0.30}. Seeds in VOLCANIC mountain hexes only. Dwarven is an ISOLATE (not ancestral to any human family). DEITY names are the Dwarven morphs of the Agrippan canon (never real Tolkien/Norse/Warhammer dwarf-gods); they take the shared sacred GENDERED ending -drumm (m) / -drumma (f) - distinct from mortal -un/-ar/-ok / -a/-na/-ra and the bare common-noun root.

phonology.palette: Gormdurn (Durnkad fire-dialect): the shared hard-frame/soft-vowel/short-syllable Durnkad, with the fire-dialect drift - word-final and medial stops GEMINATE (-un -> -unn, -ak -> -akk), o raises toward u, and the whole has a crackling, clipped, anvil-loud edge. The common-word stock is the shared Durnkad (one tongue); the gemination shows in speech and in the marked forms (titles, deities, the realm's own name).
phonology.phonotactics: CVC with frequent geminate finals; initial heavy stress; clipped, percussive.

morphology.patronymic_form: clan-primary: the clan (Kron [X]) by an ancestral line; an optional patronymic [parent]-kun (son of) / -ketta (daughter of); the forefather is named at every hearth - and, among the fire-cult, every pyre.
morphology.compounding_rule: [material|quality](hard root) + feature/hold: Gorm-grund (ember-hold), Bral-gormgrund (the great forge); -grund for the hold, Kron- for the clan.

title_ladder.government: feudal (a volcanic vault-kingdom of forge-clans, now mostly fastness-holds; the Korrunn over the clan-lords, the fire-priests and the ash-companies)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Gormdurn (fire-dialect) reflexes of the Durnkad title ladder - the same seven ACKS tiers as Khordurn and Khraaldurn, geminated (Korrun -> Korrunn). A golden-age volcanic vault-kingdom, now fastness-holds.

vassalage.fealty: Durnoath (the deep-oath, sworn on the ancestors and the fire)

people_name_convention.order: a hard-short given name + the clan (Kron [X]); dwarves are named by clan and forefather; an optional patronymic -kun/-ketta.
people_name_convention.dual_register: every dwarf carries a clan-name and a forefather; among the fire-cult, a pyre-name is added at the first offering.
people_name_convention.theophoric: mortal theophorics weave the honored power's ROOT (never the divine -drumm/-drumma ending) + a mortal ending: Marak-ok (a fire-cultist named for the forge-fire Marakkadrumm), Orlun-ar (a smith named for the forge-god).

religion._note: Deity-names are the Gormdurn reflexes of the Dwarven morphs of the Agrippan canon (family_dwarven.json) - never real dwarf-gods; sacred ending -drumm (masc) / -drumma (fem). ANCESTOR-CENTRIC like all dwarves (daily prayer to the durnad and fadrun at the tomb-hall), but the Gormdurn lean hardest into FIRE: the forge (Orlunndrumm) and, in the Chaotic fire-cult, the forge-fire/volcano power Marakkadrumm - honored with HUMAN SACRIFICE cast into the volcanoes. The drumgrund and the caldera's edge are both altars.
religion.the_one: Atrunndrumm (< Aeternus; sacred-masc -drumm; the Stone-Father, the First Shaper; honored at festivals, distant from daily prayer; named the Cold-Vault by the fire-cult)

Orlandus.gloss: the forge, the smith, oaths and iron; most honored god, masc.

Maraxus.gloss: the forge-fire and the volcano; the fire-cult's power, fed with human sacrifice; Chaotic, masc.

Gaiandus.gloss: the mountain, the mine, the deep earth; honored, masc.

worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the dwarven norm: daily prayer to the honored dead (durnad) and clan-fathers (fadrun); the gods at yearly/seasonal festivals, foremost the forge (Orlunndrumm) and the mountain/mine (Gundunndrumm); the volcano-fire (Marakkadrumm) honored AND feared, fed offerings at the caldera
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: the fire-cult (strong here): venerate Marakkadrumm the forge-fire/volcano with HUMAN SACRIFICE in the volcanoes, and Lusunndrumm the gold-sickness; demonize the One (Atrunndrumm the Cold-Vault) and the Lawful powers
worship_by_alignment.Lawful: the orderly minority revere the One (Atrunndrumm) and the Lawful powers (Orlunndrumm the smith, Gundunndrumm the mountain), demonize the Chaotic fire-cult

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the demonized set (by current alignment): when Chaotic (the fire-cult) - Aeternus -> Atrunndrumm the Cold-Vault; when Lawful - Maraxus -> Marakkadrumm the Devourer, Lusanto -> Lusunndrumm the Gold-Sickness.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Drumgrund (festival-hall) or the caldera-rite of [power]: 'the Gorm-Drumgrund of Marakkadrumm', loud with hammers and the offering-fires.
religion.saints_pattern: the honored forefathers and master-smiths of the clans (the durnad), and, in the fire-cult, the great sacrificers, named at hearth, tomb, and pyre.

holy_symbol_motifs.Orlunndrumm: a hammer crossed over an anvil
holy_symbol_motifs.Marakkadrumm: a flame rising from a cleft mountain

banks_patterns.ships: (dwarves are no sailors) magma-barges and ore-rafts on the fire-rivers: 'the Cinder Keel', 'Ember-of-the-Deep'
banks_patterns.military_units: the hold-wardens and ash-companies: 'the Cinder Guard', 'the Ash-beards of [clan]'
banks_patterns.taverns: the ale-hall: 'the Hall of the Ember Ale', 'the Molten Tankard'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: fallen fire-holds and ash-choked delfs: 'the burned Hold of [clan]', 'the Cinder-Delf of [name]'
